reply: {"action":"send_email","to":"professor@fisk.edu","subject":"Fisk University Solar Array Completion","body":"Fisk University has completed a 1.4‑MW solar array on three campus rooftops and the north parking structure. The project, finished in fourteen months and funded by state energy grants and a donor‑backed sustainability fund, is expected to supply about 28% of the campus’s annual electricity demand, saving roughly $310,000 per year in utility costs.
